t: The $(5)Anti-Personnel Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(). With this module installed, the Matrix will automatically detect unauthorised players that enter its action range and kill them - almost instantly. Friendly and hostile mobs are not harmed.
$(5)反玩家模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)结界矩阵$()的可选模块。安装此模块后，结界矩阵将自动检测进入其作用范围的未授权玩家，并几乎瞬间将其击杀。友方及敌对生物则不受影响。
